```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

```

```{r}
getwd()
list.files("../../../2019_HTS_course/wetlab/protocols/")

sample_layout.file = "../../../2019_HTS_course/wetlab/protocols/sample_and_library_info.xlsx"
excel_sheets(sample_layout.file)
```

```{r}
read_excel(sample_layout.file, sheet="2019_lab_plate", skip=6) %>%
  select(-X__1) %>%
  rename(i5index = X__2) ->
  plate_layout.df
  # as.matrix
#   column_to_rownames("X__2")
plate_layout.df
```

```{r}
gather(plate_layout.df, key="i7index", "sample", -i5index)
```


```{r}
colnames(plate_layout.df)
rownames(plate_layout.df)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
# From http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1181060
stocks <- tibble(
  time = as.Date('2009-01-01') + 0:9,
  X = rnorm(10, 0, 1),
  Y = rnorm(10, 0, 2),
  Z = rnorm(10, 0, 4)
)
stocks
```

```{r}

gather(stocks, "stock", "price", -time)
```



```{r}
plate_layout.df %>%
  as.matrix ->
  mymatrix

for(row in 1:nrow(mymatrix)) {
    for(col in 1:ncol(mymatrix)) {
      i7_index = colnames(mymatrix)[col]
      i5_index = rownames(mymatrix)[row]
      print(paste("i5", i5_index))
      print(paste("i7", i7_index))
      print(mymatrix[row, col])
    }
}
```
